```text
# PR #3725: Patch: the living board's standing scene holds the phone frame budget: card art, backs and portrait motes animate on composited layers

Closes #3674

This is the second part of #3674. Build pass 1 is already on `main` (#3691, d36774f). **`fx-phone-living-game.cy.tsx` still fails 3 of 4 on this machine**, so #3674's acceptance is not met yet. The Mythic takeover misses badly (worst frame 261–520 ms), and 360x780 and 844x390 still miss on the Anomaly cast. Per @jgoetzmann's earlier choice (option 1 in the pass-1 notes), this lands as one part and the rest stays under #3674. If the harness writes `Closes #3674` into this PR's body, a person should change it to `Part of #3674` before it merges.

## What changed

Before changing anything I recorded Chrome traces of the idle board and of each moment (Chrome 156, 4x, 390x844, with style, layout and paint invalidation tracking). I fixed the two causes I could remove without changing how anything looks:

1. **One pointer listener per card host** (`apps/web/src/cards/hostMove.ts`, new; `artLive.ts`, `tilt.ts`).
   - The trace showed every pointer move over the tilted hand card doing an extra 44-element style recalc, about 10 ms per frame at 4x. `artLive.ts` read the face's box and wrote `--art-aim-*`, then `tilt.ts` read the host's box, which forced that recalc before its own six writes.
   - `hearHostMove` runs every reader of a move first, then every write. The aim and pose values written are the same as before, and still written during the same event.
2. **The Mythic hand shimmer paints to one extent** (`cards.css`, `cf-mythic-hand-shimmer`).
   - Its box-shadow grew and shrank each frame. That made Chrome re-sort the whole page into layers every frame: about 10 ms per frame at 4x, about 3 ms without the shimmer.
   - Each keyframe now also carries the glow at 0% opacity at the widest step's size (`0 0 6px 2px`). It draws nothing but keeps the painted extent constant. With it, that cost measured about 2.7 ms per frame with the shimmer still running. The coloured shadows are unchanged.

## Tests

- `hostMove.test.tsx`:
  - readers all read before any of them writes;
  - one listener per host, removed with its last reader;
  - on a face with both live art and tilt, both boxes are read before any `setProperty`, and the values written are unchanged. This test fails on `main`, where the aim is written between the two reads.
- `handShimmer.test.ts`: every step reaches the same extent, and the coloured shadows are as R3345000 drew them. It fails on `main`, whose steps reach 5, 8 and 5 px.
- Both files are added to R3351000's `proven_in`.

## What I ran

All of these pass:
- the harness's web command: 236 files, 5041 passed, 111 skipped;
- every test that scans stylesheets, plus the motion, tilt, art-live and host-move tests: 66 files, 1495 passed;
- the 3 tests that scan the source tree by glob;
- `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck` and eslint on the changed files;
- `jackioh spec check`, `patches check` and `catalog check`;
- `classify --base origin/main --claims`, run against a throwaway commit object (HEAD and the index untouched): "Cards, micro: how cards look changed", exit 0.

## Measured

Alternating runs of `main` and this branch, Chrome 156 at 4x on this 4-core machine. Each cell is the best of 3 Anomaly-cast attempts, mean / worst frame in ms, against a budget of 50 / 120:

| Size | main, run 1 | main, run 2 | branch, run 1 | branch, run 2 | branch, run 3 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 390x844 | 55.2/99 | 53.7/111 | **47.0/96** | **47.4/87** | **43.3/90** |
| 360x780 | 53.1/114 | 50.2/124 | 51.7/147 | 50.6/119 | 45.6/139 |
| 844x390 | 56.6/143 | 51.4/119 | 49.6/148 | 51.6/141 | 55.5/162 |

- The Anomaly cast at 390x844 now passes in all three branch runs and in neither `main` run.
- Mythic takeover rows, branch: 119.6/525, 91.2/355, 74.3/279 and 134.9/518, 69.8/261, 106.3/343 and 74.2/320, 87.7/324, 103.2/347. It still fails.
- The forced-shed test passes in every run.
- The later moments were not reached, because each size stops at its first failing moment.

## What still misses, for the next pass

From the traces (390x844, 4x, traced ms per frame):
- **Every running CSS animation restyles on every frame**, composited or not, because rAF loops (the director, the aura canvas, and the spec's own sampler and pointer) produce a main-thread frame every frame. The expensive ones:
  - the face-down backs' two animations, 13–20 ms (the `.card`'s own breath plus its `::before` glow; animating only the `::before` cost about as much as no backs);
  - pass 1's lift layers, 6–12 ms;
  - SVG-image art (`g.dio`, `art-m-particle`), about 20 ms.
- **The takeover's worst frames:**
  - React's development render of the board takes 350–580 ms traced;
  - any layout that changes a size container's size relays out the whole board. The containers nest board > lane > zone > card > `.cf-scale`. One board relayout costs about 100 ms unthrottled, and 2 ms with `container-type` turned off.
- **The broadside's retry never animates**, as pass 1 found.

## Decisions the issue did not settle

- **One shared listener rather than deferring writes to `requestAnimationFrame`.** Deferring would also have kept the reads clean, but it changes when the properties land and would mean rewriting the synchronous tilt and art-live tests.
- **The clear layer is written as the glow at 0%** (`color-mix(in srgb, var(--pal-sky-300) 0%, transparent)`), not `transparent`. `surfaces.test.ts` (#2109) counts a `transparent` layer as a new one-off shadow, which would have pushed `cards.css` from 171 to 174. The alternatives were raising that count or adding a token to `surfaces.css`. Both draw nothing.
- **No change to the backs, lifts or containers.** I tried a few of these as injected-CSS experiments only:
  - lifts sized without container units: no gain;
  - backs with `container-type` turned off: no gain;
  - backs with both animations on `::before`: as cheap as no backs, but it stops the card itself from breathing.
  
  None kept the look, so I changed none of them.
- **No new ruling.** This changes no rule and nothing visible.
- **Pass 1's pending fragment is extended, not replaced.** It is still unshipped and its `visual` claim covers this change.

## Worth a second look

- `tilt.ts` "host" mode's `pointermove` is now passive. It never called `preventDefault`. The `pointerenter` listener and the drag-mode listeners are unchanged.
- That the 0% glow keeps the layer re-sort down rests on reasoning, not measurement. The trace saving was measured with plain `transparent`; the 0% form computes to the same colour, so it should behave the same, but it was never traced.

### Its own review

Built and checked on `claude-8`. This is a draft while its own review run, on the same subscription, reviews it adversarially and fixes what it finds (up to 10 rounds); CI runs on it meanwhile. Once that review approves it, it is marked ready and auto-merge turns on.

<details><summary>Rounds and checks</summary>

| Round | Builder | Checks | Review |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | build, 64.2 min | green | - |

| Gate | Result | Time |
|---|---|---|
| rustfmt (`cargo fmt --check`) | pass | 8s |
| catalog (`cargo jackioh catalog check`) | pass | 160s |
| patches (`cargo jackioh patches check`) | pass | 2s |
| rulings (`cargo jackioh spec check`) | pass | 3s |
| clippy (`cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`) | pass | 176s |
| cargo tests (`cargo test --workspace --features jackioh-engine/testkit,jackioh-engine/ts && test -z "$(git status --porcelain -- apps/web/src/wire)"`) | timed out: inconclusive, left to CI | 1800s |
| web tests (`sh scripts/build-wasm.sh && pnpm exec vitest run --project web --changed origin/main --exclude '**/src/audio/**' --exclude '**/src/fx/**' --exclude '**/src/cards/art/convention.test.ts'`) | pass | 904s |

</details>

Comment `@jgoetzmann-bot <what to change>` or `/harness revise <notes>` to ask for a revision, or `/harness stop` to stop it.
